name: 48186 · Westland, MI
findings: ZIP 48186 (Westland) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48186 (Westland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48186 (Westland) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).
